notes: Barbera is often fruity, with high acidity and less tannin than Nebbiolo.
Piedmont's whites include dry, crisp Cortese, with citrus and mineral notes.

blurb.text: A sweet, low alcohol, lightly sparkling (frizzante) white wine made from Moscato Bianco under the Asti DOCG in Piedmont, across parts of the provinces of Asti, Cuneo and Alessandria. Asti is a related wine from the same grape and area.
